title: Multi-omics fingerprint of in vitro bioengineered heart-on-chip platform
author: Gisone, Ilaria
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Harvest cells from GelMA
steps.instruction: Test enzymatic and non‑enzymatic commercial methods on GelMA hydrogel and select the collagenase‑based enzymatic method as it provides high‑throughput, fast, easy cell recovery with low interference for downstream omics.

steps.title: Extract RNA for transcriptomics
steps.instruction: Use a commercial RNA purification kit to isolate total RNA from the harvested cells according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Extract proteins for proteomics
steps.instruction: Perform tryptic digestion of the protein fraction followed by isobaric TMT labeling, using standard protocols compatible with downstream nanoLC‑Orbitrap‑MS analysis.

steps.title: Extract metabolites for metabolomics
steps.instruction: Carry out a methanolic extraction of metabolites from the harvested cells, employing a simple methanol‑based protocol to maximize metabolite recovery and prevent degradation.

steps.title: RNA‑seq analysis
steps.instruction: Sequence the purified RNA on an Illumina platform to generate transcriptomic data.

steps.title: Proteomics LC‑MS analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the TMT‑labeled peptide mixture by nanoLC coupled to an Orbitrap mass spectrometer.

steps.title: Metabolomics LC‑MS analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the methanol‑extracted metabolites using LC‑QqQ or QTOF mass spectrometry.
